description: Relatable unit conversion parameters with mandatory scientific caveats
citation: Muller, R. A., & Muller, E. A. (2015). Air Pollution and Cigarette Equivalence. Berkeley Earth.

berkeley_earth_cigarette_pm25_threshold.caveat: Cigarette equivalence is a public communication heuristic based on average statistical health hazard ratios across epidemiological studies. It is not an exact clinical diagnostic measure and does not capture toxic gas constituents, direct smoking depth of puff, or individual immunological variability.
